where: the daemon's loop, step `observe, watch and say`
what: A daemon of this lane's build (e838cddbc) ended itself with exit status 76 (LOOP_STALLED) at the end of a cold build of hello world: `loop stuck: the loop has not finished a turn and nothing moved for 120 s`, its main thread inside `loop turn: observe, watch and say` for 120.1 s, every worker idle. Two cargo builds were running on the same 32-core VM (load average about 50), and the daemon's process had 514 s of system time. The base's daemon under the same load had the same step at 2.6 s a turn (`loop stalled ... step=observe, watch and say ms=2604`, 17 times in one build). It did not happen again in four cold builds on the quiet VM, base or lane.
cost: one failed `blaze run` (395 s) and twenty minutes reading logs
cause: not measured: the flight recording holds the spans the threads were inside and no stack, and the VM has no gdb, perf or strace; that it is load is a guess from the base's 2.6 s turns in the same step
workaround: measured again with nothing else running
state: open: a stall's flight recording could hold the stalled thread's stack
